expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Version 2 is planned to expand the protocol with request identifiers for correlating messages, timestamps for creation and ordering metadata, and optional payloads for carrying additional message data while preserving the existing Ping roundtrip behavior.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with an explicit v2 envelope and encode/decode roundtrip support.
